document: Hungarian tax authority (NAV) certificate or income statement issued to a taxpayer
glossary: Document type: Hungarian tax authority (NAV) certificate or income statement issued to a taxpayer. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_title: the document title as printed on the document (Az igazolas/kimutatas cime (pl. 24M30 osszesitett igazolas, Igazolas a kifizetett jarulekokrol))
field_specs.tax_year: the tax year as printed on the document (Az igazolas adoeve/targyeve, YYYY)
field_specs.taxpayer_name: the taxpayer name as printed on the document
field_specs.tax_id: the tax id as printed on the document (A maganszemely adoazonosito jele (10 szamjegy), ha szerepel)
field_specs.employer_name: the employer name as printed on the document (A kiallito munkaltato/kifizeto/szerv neve (pl. Allianz Hungaria Zrt., The World Bank))
field_specs.income_total: the income total as printed on the document
field_specs.period: the period as printed on the document (Az igazolas idoszaka, ahogy a dokumentumon szerepel (pl. 2025. januar - 2025. december))
field_specs.issue_date: the issue date as printed on the document (Kiallitas datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.authority: the authority as printed on the document (Hatosag/intezmeny, amelyhez az igazolas kapcsolodik (pl. NAV), ha szerepel)
